The main takeaway from our work is that
, in the absence of a gold standard, the use of a single cut-off score for the MoCA or MMSE to diagnose PDMCI is not recommended.
, in the context of a large cohort of PD patients with a wide range of disease severity, a MoCA score of 25/30 or higher does not necessarily rule out the possibility of PDMCI.
